title: A Framework for Evaluating LLMs Under Task Indeterminacy

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting synthetic experiments with randomly generated data based on a causal DAG to quantify how standard 'gold label' metrics underestimate true LLM performance on indeterminate tasks.
Theoretically modeling human rating variation using a causal directed acyclic graph (DAG) to disentangle task specification, rater identity/cultural context, and exogenous rater error.
